texts.preamble: M/S Fresh Agro Food vs State Of Haryana And Others on 5 March, 2026 Author: Lisa Gill Bench: Lisa Gill Sunil Cwp-3485-2026 (O&M) In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh Cwp-3485-2026 (O&M) Date of Decision: 05.03.2026 M/S Fresh Agro Food evens Petitioner(s) Versus State Of Haryana And Others ease Respondent(s) Coram:- Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Lisa Gill Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ramesh Chander Dimri Present: Mr. Pawan Kumar, Senior Advocate with Ms. Vidushi Kumar, Advocate and Mrs. Seema Rani, Advocate for petitioner. Mr. Sourabh Goel, Advocate for respondents. ois 2K ok Lisa Gill, J. 1.
texts.facts: Petitioner's technical bid was rejected without any reason whatsoever being mentioned in impugned order/communication dated 09.01.2026 (Annexure P-6) and neither was petitioner ever informed thereof. Learned counsel for respondents, on advance notice, had been called upon on 06.02.2026, to seek instructions in this regard and thereafter, respondents were directed to file a specific affidavit of a responsible officer specifying the grounds on which petitioner had been technically disqualified. In compliance thereof short reply by way of affidavit dated 24.02.2026 of Mr. Anshaj Singh, Director General, Food Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Haryana, has been filed wherein it is stated that physical verification of petitioner's premises revealed that hygienic standards are not maintained and there is blatant contravention of the Goods Manufacturing Practices (GMP) besides statutory mandates prescribed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that petitioner has submitted its bid pursuant to tender dated 04.10.2025 (Annexure P-1) floated by Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Haryana for purchase of Fortified Rice Kernels (for short FRK). Learned counsel for respondents is, however, unable to deny that such report was never supplied to petitioner and neither is any reason mentioned in order/communication dated 09.01.2026. 4. At this stage, learned counsel for respondents submits that present writ petition in any case is rendered infructuous in view of communication dated 27.02.2026 received from Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India to The Principal Secretaries, Department of Food and Civil Supplies of all the States and Union Territories in India. It is conveyed vide said communication dated 27.02.2026 that it has been decided to temporarily discontinue universal supply of fortified rice under Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana and other Welfare Schemes of Government of India, until a more effective mechanism for delivery of nutrients to beneficiaries is identified. 5. Learned counsel for petitioner fairly states that in view thereof, at this stage, no cause of action would survive, however, in case respondent- State, at any point of time decides to continue with the Scheme, cause of action would survive.

Learned counsel for respondents is, however, unable to deny that such report was never supplied to petitioner and neither is any reason mentioned in order/communication dated 09.01.2026. 4. At this stage, learned counsel for respondents submits that present writ petition in any case is rendered infructuous in view of communication dated 27.02.2026 received from Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India to The Principal Secretaries, Department of Food and Civil Supplies of all the States and Union Territories in India. It is conveyed vide said communication dated 27.02.2026 that it has been decided to temporarily discontinue universal supply of fortified rice under Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana and other Welfare Schemes of Government of India, until a more effective mechanism for delivery of nutrients to beneficiaries is identified. 5. Learned counsel for petitioner fairly states that in view thereof, at this stage, no cause of action would survive, however, in case respondent- State, at any point of time decides to continue with the Scheme, cause of action would survive.
